name: @vanaheimr/cose
author: GraphDefined GmbH <achim.friedland@graphdefined.com>
description: CBOR Object Signing and Encryption (RFC 9052) in TypeScript, on top of the Metrological CBOR codec — the TypeScript counterpart of Vanaheimr Styx's Illias/COSE.
comment: Self-contained on purpose: src/cbor.ts is the only module that knows where the CBOR codec comes from, so lifting this directory into a repository of its own means changing that one import.
